description:
[Admin] Read the company's portal configuration as editable documents: `branding` (portal name, style, colours, logos, e-mail sender name), `interview-portal` (languages, home texts), `coaching-portal` (vertical, feature toggles, labels, languages, home blocks) and one `jobmojito.portal-site` document per portal (every page's draft content and the theme CSS). Narrow with `sections` (branding, interview-portal, coaching-portal, interview-pages, coaching-pages): the page documents are the large ones. This is the read step of every portal change: read the section(s) involved, change only what the user asked for, and send those documents back with update_portal_configuration. Field reference: https://developer.jobmojito.com/cookbooks/portal-branding/branding, https://developer.jobmojito.com/cookbooks/portal-branding/interview-portal, https://developer.jobmojito.com/cookbooks/portal-branding/coaching-portal, https://developer.jobmojito.com/cookbooks/portal-branding/portal-pages.

Reads the company's portal configuration as import documents: branding, the interview portal, the coaching portal, the sub-brands, and the pages + theme CSS + style settings + CSS files of each portal. Every returned document can be edited and sent back to portal-configuration-update unchanged in shape (preview with `dry_run: true` first). Document formats: https://developer.jobmojito.com/cookbooks/portal-branding/branding, https://developer.jobmojito.com/cookbooks/portal-branding/interview-portal, https://developer.jobmojito.com/cookbooks/portal-branding/coaching-portal, https://developer.jobmojito.com/cookbooks/portal-branding/portal-pages.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

merchant_id.description: Optional merchant to scope to. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's merchant.

sections.description: Comma-separated sections to return (default: all): branding, interview-portal, coaching-portal, interview-pages, coaching-pages, brands. A portal the company does not use is left out of the default; name its sections to read them anyway.

name: get_portal_configuration

block_types.description: With page documents (interview-pages, coaching-pages): every block type a page can hold, what it is for and its fields, in the order the editor offers them. Choose blocks from this list.

fields.description: Its own fields; every block also takes enabled, tone, anchor and className. Field details: the portal pages cookbook.

name.description: What the page editor calls it.

portals.description: The portals whose pages offer it.

use_for.description: When to choose it, with an example.

documents.description: One document per section, each a valid input for portal-configuration-update: `kind: "branding"`, `kind: "interview-portal"`, `kind: "coaching-portal"`, one `format: "jobmojito.portal-site"` per portal (`portal: "interview"` for interview-pages, `"consumer"` for coaching-pages) with every page's DRAFT content and the theme CSS draft, and `kind: "brands"` when the company's brands are switched on. With style settings switched on, a site document also holds `style_settings` and `css_files` (each file with the `version` to send back), and a page of a sub-brand holds `brand`. Pages also carry `published_at` (read-only, ignored on import; null = never published). The support / application-tracking / interview-completed / signed-in home texts are built-in pages ("_support", "_tracking", "_completion", "_signed_in_home") and appear only in the portal-site documents.

items.description: One configuration document: declares either `kind` (branding, interview-portal, coaching-portal, brands) or `format` (jobmojito.portal-site, jobmojito.portal-page), plus that type's fields. Field reference: branding https://developer.jobmojito.com/cookbooks/portal-branding/branding, interview portal https://developer.jobmojito.com/cookbooks/portal-branding/interview-portal, coaching portal https://developer.jobmojito.com/cookbooks/portal-branding/coaching-portal, portal pages https://developer.jobmojito.com/cookbooks/portal-branding/portal-pages. Unknown fields are ignored with a warning; wrong types and enum values are errors.

format.description: Portal site document type. `jobmojito.portal-site`: `{ portal, theme: { css }, style_settings, css_files: [{ path, brand, content, sort_order, version }], pages: [Page] }`, a whole site (pages in every language, the menu, the footer and the theme CSS). `jobmojito.portal-page`: `{ page: Page }`, one page. Page = `{ slug, brand, show_in_menu, sort_order, languages: [{ mojito_language_code, title, description, blocks }] }`; slug "" is the home page, "_footer", "_support", "_jobs" etc. are the built-in pages. A page's `brand` is the tag of a sub-brand, null for the main brand; a brand page can have any slug except the home page "" and the built-in pages, which belong to the main brand. `style_settings` are the main brand's colours, fonts, spacing steps, page width, corners and headings; a sub-brand's are in the brands document. `css_files` are matched by brand and path and never removed; send the `version` you read and a file changed since is refused. These parts are refused with 422 while the company's `portal_styles` or `brands` switch is off.

kind.description: Portal configuration document type. `branding`: portal name, style, colours, logos, e-mail sender name, speech term boosting. `interview-portal`: interview portal languages and the per-language home texts. `coaching-portal`: coaching portal vertical (`use_case`), feature toggles, label overrides, coaching plan, catalogue start directory, languages and per-language home blocks. `brands`: `{ brands: [{ name, tag, slug, logo_url, logo_dark_url, icon_url, privacy_notice_url, style_settings, sort_order, status }] }`, the sub-brands. A brand is matched by `tag`, which never changes; the main brand is the company itself and has no entry. A new brand needs `name`; `slug` is optional, a short name kept for older links that decides no page address (two brands cannot share one). A brand left out stays as it is; `status: "deleted"` retires one, and null clears a field. Refused with 422 while the company's `brands` switch is off. A portal site document declares `format` instead.

title: Get portal configuration
